note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: Our engineers' median salary is $108,000 against a market median of $120,000.

answers.common.decision: How to close the pay gap for engineers; the head of people decides any individual's pay.
answers.common.audience: The head of people and the finance director.
answers.common.materials: Engineering has 80 people. Voluntary turnover among engineers was 20% last year, against 12% across the company. Replacing an engineer costs us about $40,000 in recruiting and lost time.
answers.people-hr.process: Annual pay review for engineering, using our salary bands.
answers.people-hr.decider: The head of people decides any individual's pay, with the finance director's budget sign-off.
